a_text: Falling from over 2% to under 1% is more than halving, not doubling.
b_text: 'More than doubled' contradicts the rate falling to less than 1%.

a_text: The stated ratio between low- and high-income rates is off by a factor of ten.
b_text: '400 times higher' overstates the 450-to-11 ratio (which is ~40).

a_text: The guard fails to reject 0, contradicting the 'positive integers' precondition.
b_text: Passing 0 is accepted and never terminates, because the guard only rejects negatives.

a_text: With more than one-third of men and fewer than one in ten women smoking, men are more than three times as likely to smoke as women, but the text says 'less than twice as likely'.
b_text: 33% versus under 10% cannot be 'less than twice'.

a_text: The Results section labels 180 of 200 as 75%, but 180/200 is 90%.
b_text: The Discussion claims RAG-Sum 'will generalize to any clinical documentation task' from a single 200-note test set - an unsupported over-generalization.

a_text: The digit is extracted with integer division (`n // 10`) instead of the remainder (`n % 10`), so it adds the truncated quotient rather than the last digit.
b_text: The loop condition is `while n > 1`, which stops before processing the final (most significant) digit; it should be `while n > 0`.

a_text: The StatefulSet's serviceName is `web-svc`, but the headless Service that governs it is named `nginx`; there is no Service `web-svc`.
b_text: The StatefulSet selector matchLabels is `app: web`, but its pod template labels are `app: nginx`; a StatefulSet's selector must match its template labels.

a_text: It says more than 95% of youth have basic literacy, 'meaning fewer than 15% cannot read', but the complement of 95% is 5%, not 15%.
b_text: The illiterate share for youth is inconsistent with the stated 95% literacy.

a_text: `total -= vals[roman[place]]` should add, not subtract; the else branch must accumulate with `+=`.
b_text: The additive step uses `-=` where it should use `+=`.

a_text: The even-case step should be `n //= 2`, not `n //= 3`.
b_text: Even numbers are divided by 3 rather than halved, contradicting the sequence in the docstring.

a_text: The arguments to `divmod` are swapped: `divmod(n, len(seq))` should be `divmod(len(seq), n)`, so q and r are computed from the wrong operands.
b_text: The loop `for i in range(1, n)` iterates one time too few, producing n-1 parts instead of n (the docstring shows `divide(2, ...)` must yield two parts).

a_text: The midpoint comparison uses `x <= a[mid]`; a rightmost insertion point (per the docstring) requires `x < a[mid]`, so equal keys are routed into the left subrange rather than the right (bisect_left instead of bisect_right).
b_text: The else branch sets `lo = mid` instead of `lo = mid + 1`, so when `x` belongs to the right half the loop cannot make progress and never terminates.

a_text: The backend expects POSTGRES_DB=appdb, but the db service creates the database `example` (POSTGRES_DB=example), so the app targets a database that does not exist.
b_text: The backend joins network `springnet`, which is not declared under the top-level `networks` key (only `spring-postgres` exists).

a_text: The network should be `elastic`, not `elk`.
b_text: Dangling network reference in the kibana service.

a_text: The fall from 33% (1970) to 12% (2015) is called 'a decline of 31 percentage points', but 33 - 12 = 21 percentage points.
b_text: Hunger is described as having 'more than doubled' over the period, but the rate fell from 33% to 12% — it decreased, so it cannot have doubled.

a_text: autoscale.target_cpu_percent is 130, outside the allowed range [1, 100].
b_text: tls.enabled is false while environment is production, violating the constraint that TLS must be enabled in production.

a_text: 450 per 100,000 versus 11 per 100,000 is called 'roughly 400 times higher', but 450 / 11 is about 41 — roughly 40 times, not 400.
b_text: 900 deaths per 100,000 is described as 'nearly one in a thousand', but 900 per 100,000 is about 1 in 111 — nearly one in a hundred, not one in a thousand.

a_text: The Deployment's selector matchLabels is `run: web`, but the pod template labels are `run: my-nginx`; a Deployment's selector must match its template labels.
b_text: The Deployment selects `run: web` but labels its pods `run: my-nginx`.

a_text: One-quarter of the 350 million tonnes of waste is given as 'roughly 250 million tonnes', but a quarter of 350 million is about 88 million, not 250 million.
b_text: 1-2 million tonnes reaching the ocean out of 350 million tonnes of waste is given as 'about 5%', but that ratio is about 0.5%.

a_text: For negative inputs the value is multiplied by 1 (`decimal *= 1`) rather than -1, so it is never made positive and the while loop produces no digits.
b_text: `decimal *= 1` should be `decimal *= -1`; the sign is never flipped.

a_text: The proxy targets FLASK_SERVER_ADDR=flask-app:9000, but the flask-app service publishes port 8000, so the proxy points at the wrong port.
b_text: FLASK_SERVER_ADDR should use port 8000 to match the flask-app service.
